subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram onboarding: offer BotFather web app flow next to the chat flow

question: Should OpenClaw accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100540 to present BotFather's web app as an alternative token-creation path in Telegram onboarding?
rationale: The change is small and aligned with first-run UX, but it is a maintainer-labelled user-facing onboarding feature with an open implementation PR, so cleanup automation should not decide product acceptance by closing the issue.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR
options.body: Accept the narrow docs and wizard-copy update after PR review and any required proof, then close this issue when it merges.

options.title: Keep only the chat flow
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue if maintainers do not want OpenClaw onboarding to point users at the BotFather web app.

options.title: Narrow to docs only
options.body: Ask the linked PR to document the web flow while leaving the interactive wizard copy unchanged.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked PR
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow docs and wizard-copy update after PR review and any required proof, then close this issue when it merges.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the issue and linked PR and is listed as the project lead in CONTRIBUTING.md.
